dshOne.dshPath.description: Path to the dsh executable. Leave empty to look it up from PATH.
dshOne.autoStart.description: Automatically start (or reuse) the dsh web service when the extension activates.
dshOne.port.description: Port for the dsh web service. 0 lets the OS pick one; a non-zero value first probes whether a dsh instance is already running on that port and reuses it. Note that 0 breaks session restore in the dsh UI (localStorage is isolated per origin).
